title: Negative control: two bounds in one subschema, one authority
description: The control the gate went six rounds without. Every earlier control asked whether an attribution gate reaches a position; this one asks how much one answer licenses. presentation_id asserts two numbers and attributes one of them, which is exactly the shape that passed when x-authority was read per subschema instead of per bound: the attributed minLength vouched for the unattributed maxLength beside it. It is never loaded as a real schema.

presentation_id.description: The empty string is what the compiler materializes for an omitted field, so an authored empty string would be a second way to say absent.
